data.camera: medium shot, standing beside ancient desert ruins
data.description: 【凯尔希 · 荒漠考察】黄沙漫天的萨尔贡荒漠断崖边缘，凯尔希站在古代遗迹的残柱旁远眺地平线，风沙拂动她淡绿色的短发与风衣下摆。她转过身平静地开口——「千百年来，这片大地上兴起又湮灭的文明多如尘埃。博士，我们的旅途不过是漫长历史中的一页，但唯有此刻是真实的。」
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit surveys the Sargon ruins at sunset, robe and grey-green scholar cloak shifting in the desert wind as she studies the horizon solemnly. A brass astrolabe hangs at her waist beside the scholar staff. The medium view places eroded stone behind her and dunes receding beyond it. Amber late-afternoon sun illuminates cloak folds and brass, casting long ruins shadows across the sand while the farther dune slopes remain cool.
data.title: 凯尔希 · 荒漠考察
